{{Top|Lotus|Tenno|Tenno|Weapon|Weapons|Weapons}} {{WeaponInfoboxAutomatic}} {{codex|The remotely triggered Castanas quietly deliver a lethal dose of electricity to unsuspecting enemies.}} The '''Castanas''' are {{Faction|Tenno}} throwing type secondary weapons with {{D|Electricity}} detonation charge that can be detonated remotely by using the [[Alternate Fire]], much like the {{Weapon|Penta}}. Although lacking in throwing speed like other thrown weapons, they can be stacked up to six then detonated all at once to create a wide array of crowd controlling opportunities, thanks to their electrical explosion and chaining effects. ==Characteristics== *This weapon deals {{D|Electricity}} damage. **Guaranteed {{D|Electricity}} proc. *Mines can stick to surfaces, including enemies and allies. **Extra projectiles generated by [[Multishot]] have a very wide horizontal spread, effective at covering large groups of enemies. **Can only have six deployed mines out at once. ***Extra projectiles generated by [[Multishot]] will count towards this limit. *User can detonate charges on command via [[Alternate Fire]], giving the player precise timing in detonation. **Detonation has an explosion radius of '''3.6''' meters. **Up to six deployed mines can be ready for simultaneous detonation. **Explosion does not need direct line of sight to deal damage and will penetrate walls. **Explosions inflict [[Stagger|self-stagger]]. **Explosion has linear damage falloff from 100% to 60% from central impact. **Can benefit from {{M|Fulmination}} ({{M|Primed Fulmination|Primed}}). *Innate two {{Pol|Madurai}} polarities. {{Advantages| *Pinpoint [[accuracy]]. *[[Silent]], even if the projectile hits the enemy. }} {{Disadvantages| *Projectiles have very slow travel time with arcing. *Semi-automatic fire, unlike other throwing weapons. *Extremely low magazine size of just 2 rounds; requires frequent reloading. }} {{WeaponComparison|Sancti Castanas}} ==Acquisition== The Castana's blueprint can be [[research]]ed from the [[Research/Tenno Lab|Tenno Lab]] in the [[dojo]]. {{BuildAutomatic|type=Weapon}} This weapon can be sold for 5,000 credits ==Notes== *The normal animation and arc behaves similar to other thrown secondary weapons. *Castanas can stun-lock bosses such as Lech Kril. *Primary fire throws the Castanas, secondary fire detonates them. *Charges will stick to any surface (enemies, allies, [[companion]]s, etc.); after sticking, they will proc {{D|Electricity}} with 100% chance when detonated. **When thrown while running backwards, it is possible that they can stick to your Sentinel or your Frame itself. **This guaranteed {{D|Electricity}} proc does not damage the user even if when dealing self-damage. *Throws that were made by the left hand are further from reticle by a few degrees to the bottom compared to the right hand. *Can not proc {{D|Radiation}} on user. *When {{M|Magnum Force}} is added, the Castanas will begin to spread apart on throws if [[Multishot]] mods are applied. This may be helpful for combating the small blast radius they have by spacing them slightly apart from each other. *The Castanas are currently subject to a bug that dramatically increases projectile spread when using [[multishot]] mods. Equipping a low-rank {{M|Magnum Force}} will fix this. *Throwing these at an Arctic Eximus snowglobe and detonating them will kill the Eximus. *Castanas thrown by {{WF|Mirage}}'s illusions from {{A|Hall of Mirrors}} will not interfere with the maximum amount of armed Castanas at a given time. ==Tips== *Mirage's Hall of Mirrors can be used to increase the number of Castanas that can be planted, but the holograms' Castanas will detonate a few seconds after impact; though they will not damage the player and can still also be detonated manually in the given time they are active. ==Trivia== *The Castanas are the first thrown secondary weapon that delivers Area of Effect damage. *The detonation feature is similar to that of the {{Weapon|Penta}} grenade launcher, which also allowed users to detonate on command. *The word ''Castañas'' means "chestnuts" in Spanish and Greek, judging how the knives are thrown, then "open" themselves, revealing their explosive cores. *The Castanas are the first throwable weapon of its kind to be thrown in "Semi-auto". ==Bugs== *If Multishot is modded onto the Castanas in any way and happens to activate, the castanas thrown will travel in widely different directions, landing far away from the intended target. **This can be counteracted with {{M|Magnum Force}}. ==Media== Castanaspic.png|Castanas In The Market Castanas-Website.jpg|Castanas in Website {{VideoGallery |{{YouTube|7SbkkoQabTc|size=300px}} |{{YouTube|iLvkvaerr3U|size=300px}} |{{YouTube|6zY3TOlnq7k|size=300px}} }} {{SkinGallery}} ==Patch History== {{Scrollbox/Article| {{ver|32.2}} *Fixed the Critical Chance and Status Chance stats not being listed for the Castanas in the Arsenal. {{ver|32}} ;Ammo Changes We understand the power fantasy of these weapons is very popular for some, so our first approach was to keep them powerful, but limit how often they can be used by making changes to ammo pick-up. '''''Ammo Pickup Overrides'''''
The following weapons now have ammo pickup overrides, meaning they gain less from picking up ammo. This mostly applies to AoE weapons, in hopes that players will become more deliberate with their aim to make the most of their Ammo pools. The following lists the specific ammo pick up overrides per weapon category. '''Secondary Weapon Ammo Pick Up Overrides''' 4 Ammo per Pick Up: *Castanas ;GENERAL CHANGES: *Updated thrown weapons to now only show a single projectile in hand when only one 1 projectile is remaining before reloading. This affects the following weapons: **Castanas {{ver|27.2.2}}
Reduced the following AoE weapons Radial Damage Falloff from central impact that were all previously 90%: *Castanas: 40% {{ver|27.2}} ;Self Damage Changes: We are getting rid of Self Damage and replacing it with something else: instead of Self Damage, it’s now ‘Stagger’. This change completely removes the chance of killing yourself, and instead now creates scenarios where you will interrupt yourself - or ‘Stagger’ - to varying degrees if you aren’t careful. The degrees of Self-Interrupt start with a small stumble all the way to full knockdown depending on how close you are to the center of explosion. Any Mods referring to Self Damage will be converted to acknowledge Stagger. With this Self-Interrupt system, we have added dozens of new recovery animations that harness a ninja-like recovery experience. By pressing ‘Jump’ at the correct time, you can execute a ninja-skill-based knockdown recovery to ALL in-game knockdowns. This ninja recovery window is indicated by a glowing FX on your Warframe. In the original Dev Workshop, we said:
''As a result of this overall systemic change, Weapons with Stagger will be getting approximately a 20% buff in Damage, with any weapons with AOE receiving a 50% Radial Damage Falloff from central impact.'' This is no longer accurate after continued testing. What we are doing now is: No damage buffs have been added, but any weapons with AOE are receiving ~20% increase in Radius. Additionally, AOE weapons are receiving a 90% Radial Damage Falloff from central impact. This means on the very outer section of the explosion Radius 10% of the Damage will be dealt. Tactics will be deadly - aim true, Tenno. ''Why: Several players brought up the history of the Tonkor and we want to make sure we ship this change in a place that’s conservative in its starting point from a balance perspective. The complete removal of Self Damage does change the pace of destruction with some of the game’s most powerful weapons, so we want to make sure we can iterate upwardly instead of releasing a bonanza of explosions with no other choices.'' {{ver|24.8}} *Fixed equipping Castanas (in default Skin) placing a larger version of one of the projectiles between the Warframes legs. {{ver|23.10}} *Updated weapon FX for the Castanas. {{ver|22.20}} ;Conclave: *Reduced the ammo pool of the Castanas. *Increased the effect of gravity on the Castanas. {{ver|22.13.3}} *Made the additional projectiles of Castanas from Multishot spread in a more uniform/predictable pattern. {{ver|22.12}} *Damage increased from 100 to 160. *Status chance increased from 10% to 22%. *Critical chance increased from 5% to 8%. *Increased speed of projectile. *Deployed damage radius increased from 2m to 3m. *Multishot now spreads additional projectiles horizontal only. *Ammo pool decreased from 30 to 18. {{ver|21}} *Fixed {{M|Magnum Force}} equipped on Castanas modded for multishot resulting in pin-point accuracy. {{ver|20.5}} *Reduced the detonation delay of detonated explosive weapons (Castanas, etc). {{ver|15.12.2}} *Fixed an issue causing attachments on the regular Castanas to turn grey. {{ver|14.2}} *Ammo capacity reduced from 210 to 30. {{ver|14.1.3}} *Tweaked the visual fidelity of Castanas explosions spawned from Hall of Mirror clones. {{ver|13.8}} *Fixed an issue with Clients sometimes being able to throw unlimited amounts of Castanas which they could not detonate. {{ver|12.5.3}} *Fixed a duplicate flashlight being present on the Castanas. {{ver|12.4.5}} *Fixed inability to throw Castanas while sprinting. {{ver|12.3}} *Adjusted timing to show Castanas in hand sooner after reload is complete. {{ver|12.2}} *Introduced. }} {{ver/Lu|24.8}} ==See also== *{{Weapon|Sancti Castanas}}, the [[New Loka]] custom version. *{{Weapon|Talons}}, explosive bombs that work much like the Castanas {{ResearchNav}} {{WeaponNav}} [[de:Castanas]] [[es:Castanas]] [[fr:Castanas]] [[Category:Tenno]] [[Category:Research]] [[Category:Update 12]] [[Category:Electricity Damage Weapons]] ==Notes==
*'''Catalyzer Link''' is additive with similar mods. For example, a {{Weapon|Kuva Karak}} with a max rank '''Catalyzer Link''' and a max rank {{M|Galvanized Aptitude}} will have a {{Math|31% {{mul}} (1 + 60% + 80%)|t=y|p=y}} status chance.
*While a secondary or melee weapon is equipped, Catalyzer Link's buff icon still triggers when an ability is cast; this appears to be a lingering effect to reap the benefits of the mod when you switch to your primary, as status chance does not seem to increase for secondary and melee weapons.

[[Category:Launcher (Primary)]] {{Top|Enemy|Corpus|Corpus|Weapon|Weapons|Weapons}} {{WeaponInfoboxAutomatic}} {{Codex|Enveloped in deep red composite enamel, this Penta variant features a higher fire-rate and over-sized magazine.}} The '''Carmine Penta''' is a special variant of the {{Weapon|Penta}} grenade launcher, featuring a higher fire rate and doubled magazine size. ==Characteristics== *This weapon deals primarily {{D|Blast}} damage. *Can only have five grenades out at once. **Extra projectiles generated by [[Multishot]] will count towards the limit of five live grenades. *Grenades explode in '''4''' meter radius on impact with a surface or enemy. **Initial hit and explosion apply [[status]] separately. **Explosion does not need direct line of sight to deal damage and will penetrate walls. **Can benefit from {{M|Firestorm}} ({{M|Primed Firestorm|Primed}}) and {{M|Cautious Shot}}. **Explosions can cause [[Stagger|self-stagger]]. *Can use the launcher-exclusive {{M|Adhesive Blast}} mods, as well as the Penta-exclusive {{M|Tether Grenades}} and {{M|Napalm Grenades}} mods. {{Advantages|class=Launcher| *Pinpoint [[accuracy]]. **{{M|Heavy Caliber}}'s accuracy penalty is minimal on this weapon. }} {{Disadvantages|class=Launcher| *Grenades have slow travel time and heavy arcing. *Slow [[reload speed]]. *Grenades have a high bouncing capability which makes it hard to stack on a desired spot. **Can bounce off teammates or companions, potentially causing self stagger. **This can be countered with the {{M|Adhesive Blast}} mod which will make the grenades stick to any surface. **{{M|Tether Grenades}} counters this, with the additional benefit of keeping a tethered enemy from leaving the blast radius. *Explosion inflicts [[Stagger|self-stagger]]. *Explosion has a [[Enemy Body Parts|headshot]] multiplier of 1x and cannot trigger headshot conditions. *Explosion has linear damage falloff from 100% to 50% from central impact. }} {{WeaponComparison|Penta}} {{WeaponComparison|Secura Penta|header=n}} {{Acquisition|This weapon's blueprints and components can be obtained from [[Pluto Proxima]] or [[Veil Proxima]] [[Corpus]]-controlled [[Empyrean#Abandoned_Derelict_Caches|Abandoned Derelict Caches]] in [[Empyrean]] missions. All parts can be [[Trading|traded]] between players.}} {{BuildAutomatic|type=Weapon}} ==Notes== *Although it features twice the magazine size of the regular Penta, the name remains accurate, as only a maximum of five grenades can be active. *Grenades will immediately explode when they hit [[Blunt]]s, water surface, puddles from [[Tar Mutalist MOA]], or [[Tectonics|Bulwarks]]. ==Media== File:Warframe Carmine Penta Meme Mags.jpg|thumb|How it looks with every magazine mod equipped Carmine Penta 1.png|Carmine penta as it appears in the arsenal Carmine Penta 2.png {{YouTube|lt3yCDm_f4g|size=335px|align=center}} {{SkinGallery}} ==Trivia== *Carmine refers to a bright red pigment derived from various insects. *This weapon used to be exclusive to [[WARFRAME (China)]], through a rebate program after purchasing at least [[wikipedia:Yuan_(currency)|¥1]] worth of [[Platinum]]. It has been available to the global build since {{ver|29.10}}. ==Patch History== {{Scrollbox/Article| {{ver|33}} *Fixed being unable to chat link Carmine Penta components. {{ver|32}} ;Ammo Changes We understand the power fantasy of these weapons is very popular for some, so our first approach was to keep them powerful, but limit how often they can be used by making changes to ammo pick-up. '''''Ammo Pickup Overrides'''''
The following weapons now have ammo pickup overrides, meaning they gain less from picking up ammo. This mostly applies to AoE weapons, in hopes that players will become more deliberate with their aim to make the most of their Ammo pools. The following lists the specific ammo pick up overrides per weapon category. '''Primary Weapon Ammo Pick Up Overrides''' 5 Ammo per Pick Up: *Carmine Penta ;Headshot Damage Changes During playtesting, the ammo changes alone weren’t enough to significantly change things for AoE weapons. So instead of tightening these values to be overly restrictive, we chose to address other factors that make these weapons so strong, such as headshot damage. Our approach here is two-fold, to reduce the impact of headshots for AOE weapons, but to also make precision headshots pack a larger punch overall. *Radial damage no longer gains extra headshot damage or triggers headshot conditions. **This is primarily targeted at the Ignis Wraith - as a “flamethrower” weapon, it’s hard to imagine a blanket of elements being precise enough to target weak points specifically. Explosive projectiles themselves can still land headshots, so there is still a reason to aim with most weapons for maximum damage. {{ver|29.10}} *Introduced. }} ==See Also== *{{Weapon|Penta}}, the original version. *{{Weapon|Secura Penta}}, the [[The Perrin Sequence|Perrin Sequence]] custom version. {{WeaponNav}} [[es:Penta Carmine]] [[Category:Warframe China Timed Exclusive]] [[uk:Пента-кармін]]

{{Top|Enemy|Infested|Infested|Weapon|Weapons|Weapons}} {{WeaponInfoboxAutomatic}} {{Codex|Splatter enemies with a short-range stream of corrosive bile and then toss the ammo bladder as a grenade when reloading. The emptier the pistol's ammo bladder, the more potent its damage. A fully empty bladder packs the biggest punch.}} '''Catabolyst''' is an {{Faction|Infested}} sidearm that fires a short-ranged beam of {{D|Corrosive}} bile. When reloading, the Catabolyst's clip is thrown like a grenade, with greatly increased potency if reloading from an empty clip. ==Characteristics== *This weapon primarily deals {{D|Corrosive}} damage. *Primary beam: **Has linear damage falloff from '''100%''' to '''1.88%''' from 9m to 19m target distance. Distance is affected by [[Projectile Speed]] but do not increase the maximum range of the beam. **Consumes 0.5 ammo per tick of damage. **Damage ramps up from 20% to 100% over 0.6 seconds when firing. After firing stops for 0.8 seconds, the damage decays back to 20% over 2 seconds. **The zone of impact or maximum beam range has a spherical blast radius of '''0.7''' meters, bringing up the total range to 19.7 meters before mods, allowing it to hit multiple enemies at once. ***Radial damage is not affected by [[multishot]]. ***Radius is affected by {{M|Fulmination}} ({{M|Primed Fulmination|Primed}}). *Reload throws a grenade at the reticle that explodes in '''5''' - '''7''' meter radius on impact with a surface or enemy. **Damage, [[critical chance]], status chance, and explosion range increase when reloading with no ammo in the magazine. **Reload from empty has an innate '''-20%''' [[Reload|Reload Speed]] buff applied to it's base reload time of '''1.7''' seconds, increasing the time it takes to reload to '''2.125''' seconds. ***Bonus is additive with {{M|Quickdraw}} and similar bonuses. **Initial hit and explosion apply status separately. **Explosion does not need direct line of sight to deal damage and will penetrate walls. **Has travel time. **Weapon must be completely emptied from a full magazine in order maximize the use of the grenade. **Radius is '''not''' affected by {{M|Fulmination}} ({{M|Primed Fulmination|Primed}}). **Grenade is thrown mid-reload, interrupting the reload (e.g. with [[Self-stagger]], or a [[Melee]] attack) will let you throw it again ad infinitum. *Can equip the Catabolyst-exclusive {{M|Critical Mutation}} mod. *Innate {{Pol|Madurai}} polarity. {{Advantages|class=Pistol|trigger=Held|}} {{Disadvantages|class=Pistol|trigger=Held| *Will never reload on its own, must be reloaded manually. *Primary beam: **Limited range of '''19''' meters. Range is affected by {{M|Ruinous Extension}}. *Reload grenade: **Explosion inflicts [[Stagger|self-stagger]]. **Explosion has a [[Enemy Body Parts|headshot]] multiplier of 1x and cannot trigger headshot conditions. **Explosion has linear [[Damage Falloff]] from 100% to 50% from central impact.}} {{WeaponComparison|Coda Catabolyst}} ==Acquisition== The Catabolyst's blueprint can be [[research]]ed from the [[Research/Bio Lab|Bio Lab]] in the [[dojo]]. {{BuildAutomatic|type=Weapon}} ==Notes== *Will not reload automatically on an empty magazine, preserving the grenade. The player must manually reload the weapon to toss it out and refill the magazine. **Cannot throw the grenade if reserve ammo is completely depleted. *If reload is interrupted after throwing an empty clip, reloading again will throw a weaker grenade. This includes if the player is knocked back from a full magazine explosion. *The grenade throwing animation speed is affected by [[reload speed]]. *{{M|Synth Charge}} increases the grenade damage. *Increasing magazine capacity has no effect on grenade damage. *[[Punch Through]] does not affect the beam or grenade. ==Bugs== *[[Multishot]] does not affect the reload grenade. *{{M|Galvanized Shot}} is multiplicative to base damage sources on direct hits from thrown grenade in both empty and partially empty states. ==Tips== * Starting the reload animation and then rolling or interrupting the action throws the grenade without neither reloading the weapon nor consuming ammo, allowing for the grenade to be spammed over and over. * As this weapon has innate {{D|Corrosive}} damage, very high status chance, and the primary fire uses very powerful beam [[Multishot]] mechanics, it is able to very effectively build into {{D|Corrosive}}, {{D|Viral}}, and either {{D|Electricity}} or {{D|Heat}} damage all at the same time. The first two procs tend to cap and provide their maximum bonuses almost instantly, while the single element Damage over Time effects will stack up dozens of procs. ===Farming Tips===
*Thrax enemies are abundant in [[Mobile Defense]] and [[Void Cascade]] missions.
*The Zariman Arcane drop is considered as a mod drop, and is thus affected by [[The Steel Path]] and [[Mod Drop Chance Booster]].

==Notes==
*Creates an extra instance of damage when proccing a status effect.
*More than 1 status proc on a single hit (>100% Status chance) will properly add extra damage, but will be displayed as a single damage number.
*Not affected by damage, element, physical, {{M|Galvanized Shot}} stacks, {{M|Synth Charge}}, or critical mods and bonuses.
*Affected by faction mods and bonuses once.
*Not affected by {{A|Eclipse}} or {{WF|Garuda}}'s passive.
*Triggers on {{D|Toxin}} procs by {{A|Toxic Lash}}.
*Does '''not''' trigger on {{D|Void}} procs by {{A|Xata's Whisper}}, and {{D|Cold}} spores of {{Weapon|Dual Coda Torxica}}.
*Affected by [[Damage Vulnerability]] like {{WF|Caliban}}'s {{A|Sentient Wrath}} , {{WF|Gara}}'s {{A|Mass Vitrify}} and {{A|Splinter Storm}}.
*Not affected by weakspots, but is affected by enemy damage reduction. For example, striking a Nox in the face will still have Cascadia Empowered's damage reduced by its body's damage reduction.
*Not affected by weapon falloff such as on shotguns and explosions.
*Can proc off of {{Focus|Zenurik}}'s {{Focus|Temporal Shot}} bonus when used with {{A|Seeking Talons}}.

==Tips==
*Indirectly affected by [[Fire Rate]] and [[Multishot]] mods.
*Unlike other secondary arcanes, Cascadia Empowered has no activation conditions, giving weapons more up-front damage to activate other conditional effects such as {{M|Galvanized Diffusion}}.
*Most effective on weapons with high status proc rates (Status Chance per Pellet {{Mul}} Fire Rate {{Mul}} Innate Multishot {{Mul}} Explosions). In order of highest base burst proc rate, these include:
**{{Weapon|Kompressa Prime}} (9.6 on direct hits), {{Weapon|Twin Grakatas}} (6.6), {{Weapon|Kuva Brakk}} {{Tooltip|(6.5)|Has a fire rate cap of 10}}, {{Weapon|Catabolyst}} (5.2), {{Weapon|Kuva Nukor}} (5), {{Weapon|Tenet Cycron}} (4.8), {{Weapon|Gaze|Gaze (Secondary)}} (4.7 with Flutterfire or Ramflare), {{Weapon|Twin Kohmak}} (4.6 at full spool), {{Weapon|Zakti Prime}} {{Tooltip|(4.2 on direct hits)|Not including guaranteed impact proc on direct hits}}, {{Weapon|Quatz}} (4.1 on auto).
*{{A|Seeking Talons}} causes all hits to proc {{D|Slash}}, adding an extra instance of Cascadia Empowered to every hit from the secondary weapon, except for status ticks.

== Tips == * With high [[fire rate]] weapons such as {{Weapon|Spectra}}, Cascadia Flare's max stack can be reached rather quickly despite its tendency to lose all its stacks upon expiry. * Equipping a sentinel with a high-status companion weapon such as [[Verglas]] — modded for viral and heat, fire rate and multishot — can effectively help keep the stacks of Cascadia Flare maxed. * Works well on secondaries with innate Heat damage and high [[status chance]] such as the {{Weapon|Atomos}}, {{Weapon|Hystrix}} ({{Weapon|Hystrix Prime|Prime}}) with Heat Quills, and {{Weapon|Tenet Cycron}}, as long as Heat is included among the listed elemental damage and not its derivatives such as {{D|Gas}}. ** Also works very well with weapons that possess a base secondary elemental damage type and high status chance such as the {{Weapon|Synoid Gammacor}} and {{Weapon|Kompressa}} when combined with {{M|Primed Heated Charge}}, as long as the added Heat is included as a damage type. *If a secondary [[Exalted Weapon]] is modded for {{D|Heat}}, there is multi-point synergy from Cascadia Flare with {{Arcane|Arcane Hot Shot}}, and the {{Resource|Topaz Archon Shard}} [[Topaz_Archon_Shard#Shard_Buffs|buff]] for secondary critical chance on {{D|Heat}} kills. **This trifecta produces a combined 480% base damage bonus and up to a maximum 675% bonus [[Critical Hit|critical chance]] for secondary weapons. *The [[Helminth]]-subsumable ability {{A|Jade Stars}} launches motes capable of inflicting multiple {{D|Heat}} procs per second in line with the player's attacks, making any frame capable of producing many {{D|Heat}} procs **Because {{A|Jade Stars}} produces so many procs so reliably, it can potentially stack and maintain the Flare buff without weapon procs, allowing for an elemental damage mix on the weapon that doesn't necessarily involve {{D|Heat}} as a final element. == Bugs == *If installed in the secondary arcane slot of an [[Archgun]]
